name: Threat Intel for AWS - Amazon VPC Flow Logs - New
description: Review this dashboard for details on potential threats and IOCs for AWS VPC Flow Logs.
title: Threat Intel for AWS - Amazon VPC Flow Logs - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/VPC 
| json "message"
| parse field=message "* * * * * * * * * * * * * *" as version,accountID,interfaceID,src_ip,dest_ip,src_port,dest_port,Protocol,Packets,bytes,StartSample,EndSample,Action,status
| lookup type, actor, raw , threatlevel as malicious_confidence,threat   from sumo://threat/cs on src_ip=threat
| where type="ip_address"
| json field=raw "malware_families[*]" as threat_malware_families
| json field=raw "last_updated" as last_updated
| formatDate(fromseconds(last_updated), "MM-dd-yyyy") as threat_last_updated 
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name 
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| concat ( src_ip," : ", src_port) as src
| concat ( dest_ip," : ", dest_port) as dest
| if (isNull(actor) or actor="","Unassigned",actor) as actor 
| timeslice 1h
|where if ("{{threat_malware_families}}" = "*", true, threat_malware_families matches "{{threat_malware_families}}") AND if ("{{accountid}}" = "*", true, accountid matches "{{accountid}}") AND if ("{{malicious_confidence}}" = "*", true, malicious_confidence matches "{{malicious_confidence}}") AND if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{actor}}" = "*", true, actor matches "{{actor}}") AND if ("{{last_updated}}" = "*", true, last_updated matches "{{last_updated}}") AND if ("{{threat_last_updated}}" = "*", true, threat_last_updated matches "{{threat_last_updated}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{src_port}}" = "*", true, src_port matches "{{src_port}}") AND if ("{{interfaceid}}" = "*", true, interfaceid matches "{{interfaceid}}") AND if ("{{label_name}}" = "*", true, label_name matches "{{label_name}}")
|count by _timeslice, Action
| transpose row _timeslice column Action

|count by latitude, longitude, label_name,threat_last_updated
